items.title: A study of Coagadex for Acquired Factor X Deficiency was cancelled before it began
items.summary: Kedrion S.p.A. planned this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “Study was discontinued for non-safety reasons and the rapidly evolving treatment landscape for AL amyloidosis”. The registry doesn’t say when it was cancelled. The date above is when its record was last updated.

items.title: Results posted for a study of FX006 Injection for Rotator Cuff Tears
items.summary: Northwell Health ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 40 people. It was stopped early. The study team’s reason: “The primary reasons for early study termination are administrative and funding issues and inability to obtain the investigational product; this lead to insufficient participant enrollment”. The registry lists its end date as 9 Oct 2025. The study team posted its results on ClinicalTrials.gov. Our search of PubMed and Europe PMC for this study’s number (NCT04094298) found no journal article. Searches can miss articles, so one may already exist. We don’t say here whether the treatment worked. The official study record has the full results.

items.title: A study of Poziotinib for NSCLC is paused
items.summary: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals, Inc leads this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “The study has not enrolled any patients. The date above is when its record was last updated.
